column2: [14] Federatsiyagrad

Kwalasha’s capital has been the recent focal point in the war against the Bug, leaving much of the city in ruins.

While brave defenders hang on to a sliver of urban territory, the preparations for a powerful counter-attack are already underway.
Do not lose the foothold
Clear all Bug Hives
Capture a Satellite Station

column2: Foothold
Traffic Control Terminal
The bridgehead's been overrun!
Careful, they’re going to flank you
Where? I don’t see them.
Not yet. They’ll do it in the future.
Watch our flank!
That slimy son of a bitch was right.
You know you’re still on radio.
I know.
Here they come again. Keep shooting, rinse and repeat.
Reinforcements just left the ships. They’ll be entering the atmosphere momentarily.
Hold on people, we’re almost through this. Tomorrow’s a new day to die.
This bridgehead is the last line of defense. If it goes, there’s nothing between bugs and the refugee camps.
Please keep those civilians safe. We need them back in the factories when all this is over.
Reinforcements will come across when they can, but Command is keeping a tight rein on their supplies.
It’s all up to you. Don’t let those Arachnids get past.
Hell yes, here comes the cavalry! Counter-attacking troopers are dropping in behind enemy lines.
We need to get one of those stations up and running...
...then we can start taking this city back.
More reinforcements have arrived in the city.
Well, that's the surface clear. But those tunnels are still full of Bugs. I pity whoever's going to have to go down there and clear them out...
The bug hive in the middle of the city is exceptionally powerful. I would advise not engaging it until you have secured the rest of the area.
I'm not not one for backing down from a fight.
An admirable quality in a warfighter, but trust me on this one.  Wait until the other hives have been taken out - then you'll get your chance.
Base is online! Call down some backup.
Okay, let’s drive those bugs back to the river.

We've taken the traffic control center. Cameras are coming online and we have access to all the city's traffic gates.  Makes it easier for us to get around and also means we can funnel the Bugs' movements.
The city’s traffic control room is nearby. If we can reach it, we’ll gain remote access over the cameras and security gates. Might come in handy.
Hm... yes, that could be advantageous.
Seems like military intelligence doesn’t know everything.
Sensors are picking up strong Bug activity in the metro tunnels beneath the city.  I'd suggest you organize your troops into defensive positions.
Another strong reading from the underground sensors.
Looks like the Bugs are pretty pissed we stomped one of their nests.  Get yourselves ready people!
Another attack wave is heading for the foothold!
